sections.title: Can SMP Treatment and Hair Transplant Be Combined – Scalp Micropigmentation + Transplantation?
text: Yes – combining SMP (scalp micropigmentation) and a hair transplant is often the best approach to hair loss.
Example of SMP vs Transplant combination:
A man undergoes a hair transplant and gains a new hairline, but density after the procedure is insufficient.
With the help of SMP (scalp micropigmentation), shading creates the illusion of double density – the hair tattoo fills the gaps between transplanted hairs.
The combination of SMP and hair transplant is highly effective for baldness when you want both natural hair structure (transplant) and visual fullness (scalp micropigmentation Ljubljana).
